original_ai_output.title_zh: 基金会发起倡议预防尼日尔三角洲2027年选举暴力
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日尔三角洲伙伴关系倡议基金会（PIND）宣布启动一项多利益相关方倡议，旨在预防和缓解尼日利亚2027年大选前尼日尔三角洲地区的选举相关暴力。该项目覆盖阿夸伊博姆、三角洲和河流三州的24个高风险地方政府区域，通过实时风险监测、协调响应和负责任的媒体报道开展工作。PIND表示该倡议严格保持无党派立场，并已与当地伙伴签署合作协议。

key_facts.fact: PIND基金会启动多利益相关方倡议，预防尼日利亚2027年大选前尼日尔三角洲地区的选举暴力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Foundation for Partnership Initiatives in the Niger Delta (PIND) has inaugurated a multistakeholder initiative to prevent and mitigate election-related violence ahead of Nigeria's 2027 general elections in Niger Delta.

key_facts.fact: 项目覆盖阿夸伊博姆、三角洲和河流三州的24个高风险地方政府区域
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The project targets 24 high-risk local government areas across Akwa Ibom, Delta and Rivers with real-time risk monitoring, coordinated response and responsible media engagement.

key_facts.fact: PIND与三个州的当地伙伴签署了合作协议，建立联合实施框架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: PIND signed Memoranda of Agreement with Youth for Change Initiative in Akwa Ibom, and One Love Community Development and Promotion of Peace Initiative in Delta.

key_facts.fact: PIND表示该倡议严格保持无党派立场，目的是保护生命并支持可信的选举进程
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The project is strictly non-partisan. Its purpose is to protect lives, strengthen peaceful civic participation and support credible electoral processes

key_facts.fact: PIND此前曾在尼日利亚2015、2019和2023年选举周期中支持选举暴力预防工作
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: PIND previously supported election-related violence prevention during Nigeria's 2015, 2019 and 2023 electoral cycles

uncertainties: 该倡议的实际效果尚待观察
目前仅单一来源（尼日利亚通讯社NAN）报道
